description: This file defines the Drupal core Cron service class, responsible for scheduling and executing cron tasks, managing queues, invoking module cron hooks, and handling locking and timing for cron runs.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Cron
classes.description: The Drupal core Cron service class responsible for scheduling, executing, and managing cron tasks and queues.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the cron process: acquires lock, invokes module hooks, processes queues, and releases lock.

methods.name: setCronLastTime
methods.description: Records the last cron execution time in the system state.

methods.name: processQueues
methods.description: Processes all configured cron queues, handling delays and re-queuing as necessary.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Processes individual queue items, handling requeue, delay, suspension, and exceptions.

methods.name: invokeCronHandlers
methods.description: Invokes all module hook_cron implementations, with logging and timing.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds.
